first_ticket_intro: Cleared adds one line to the README of {service}, then asks for your approval before anything ships.
first_ticket_no_workspace: Connect a repository first: the first ticket changes one line in it.
first_ticket_flow_note: The author proposes its plan first. Another model then reviews the change, and nothing ships without your approval.
first_ticket_now_working: The author is making the change.
first_ticket_now_plan: The plan is ready and waits for your go.
first_ticket_now_review: Another model is reviewing the change.
first_ticket_now_approval: The review passed. Shipping waits for your approval.
first_ticket_now_merging: Approved. The change is shipping, and Cleared is watching the project.
first_ticket_now_stopped: The ticket left the flow. Open its session to see why.
first_ticket_rolled_back: The watch rolled it back, so the ticket went back to the start.
first_ticket_summary_all: {all} in all: {person} of your time and {machine} of the machine's.
first_ticket_error_no_workspace: No repository is connected yet. Connect one first.
first_ticket_error_unknown_service: This repository is not connected. Pick one from the list.
first_ticket_error_exists: The first ticket is already made. Reload the page to follow it.
first_ticket_error_unsigned: Cleared cannot sign for you yet: its approval signature is missing. Open the owner's step.
first_ticket_error_other: The first ticket could not be made. Try again in a moment.
first_ticket_intro_many: Cleared adds one line to the README of a repository, then asks for your approval before anything ships.
